scope: First 15 seconds only; no full-recording mapping, mesh, ground flattening or tree symmetry constraints

source.policy: All packet types within the first capture-time interval only; full release ZIP checksum verified before extraction. No stationary results read or changed.

SLAM.backend: Ouster SDK LIOSlamEngine, same engine as ouster-cli slam

packets.caution: Accelerometer median under vehicle motion is approximate, not surveyed Earth vertical or a fitted tree-up correction.

GNSS_diagnostic.time_alignment: No sufficient overlap between PCAP host Unix timestamps and GPS log; no invented offset

held_out_consistency.policy: 20% fixed pixel returns withheld from SDK training in every frame, including second returns at those pixels. Identical held-out queries matched against held-out points five processed scans earlier. 10 cm capped nearest-neighbour cost; density/occlusion-sensitive internal diagnostic, not survey accuracy.

ground_diagnostic.caution: Dominant measured low surface only; a real orchard floor can slope or have grass ridges. This fit is diagnostic and never flattens points or changes poses.

export.source_return: first return only; dual-return raw channels retained in processed OSF
export.sample_policy: One real return per 4 cm frame voxel, then one per 2.5 cm map voxel; no averaged/invented points
export.RGB: Existing shared stationary leaf/wood model used only for provisional display; different acquisition/illumination not revalidated; never used by this SLAM fit

limitations: Internal diagnostics only, no surveyed accuracy guarantee.
GNSS uses uncalibrated capture-host timing and antenna lever arm; no GNSS constraints fitted.
No loop closure or pose graph optimization in this first-pass pilot.
180-degree view and repeated orchard geometry can cause drift, and foliage can move.
